scripts/macos_system_deps.sh

Shell · Tier B

Discover or install supported macOS Python prerequisites for current installers.

Usage

Source from root/macOS Gateway installation; provides shared discovery functions.

Inputs

PYTHON_BIN, AOR_MACOS_PACKAGE_MANAGER and system-dependency skip controls. Supports 64-bit Python 3.11+ on Intel/Apple Silicon.

Side effects

Can invoke an existing Homebrew/MacPorts installation for packages; does not bootstrap those managers or change shell profiles/global Python selection.

Cleanup

Functions return to the sourcing installer, which owns failure and environment creation.

@see install.sh
